lastCompletedStory.title: Idle-guarantee before pushing into the orchestrator pane

nextStoryContext: US-008 complete. src/tmux/dispatch.ts introduces sendKeysWhenIdle (idle-check via capture-pane polling before send-keys) and isOrchPaneIdle (exported for testing). All thin-proxy commands (plan, next, issue, review, ship) now use sendKeysWhenIdle instead of bare tmuxSpawnFn send-keys. Key invariants: idle detection checks last 5 lines for spinner glyphs (braille set) or active tool-call glyph (◆), then confirms a prompt line ending with > or ❯; timeout fallback logs to stderr and still sends. All test fake spawn fns updated to handle capture-pane subcommand (returning '> ') so idle check passes immediately. 893 tests pass, 0 fail. Check prd.json for next highest-priority passes=false non-operator story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-008 is a pure internal feature (capture-pane polling + idle-check logic). No new external JS library was introduced. tmux capture-pane is a well-known system command; the -p -t <paneId> flags are stable across all tmux 3.x versions.
